phases.objective: Replace manual reconstruction of Frontend surface dispatch failures with one exact-candidate structured report and align validation and refresh generation against the same freshly fetched main baseline.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Frontend surface dispatch on a pull request or explicit workflow dispatch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow publishes bounded JSON and Markdown identifying the first failed verification stage, or proves all generator, auth, OpenAPI, route-coverage, and committed-output checks on the exact merge candidate without requiring Job-log reconstruction.
steps: Checkout the exact candidate without persisted credentials for validation.
Fetch the canonical default branch and force the local canonical ref to the fetched origin ref.
Generate frontend dispatch, operation-governance, and runtime OpenAPI evidence against that exact canonical ref.
Run each frontend verification command as a named ordered evidence stage.
Check committed generated-output parity as a named evidence stage.
Stop at the first failure and retain bounded redacted diagnostics.
Upload the structured report before enforcing its decision.
Use the same fetched-main synchronization in the bounded refresh job.
assertions: Pull-request evidence records merge-candidate SHA separately from source-head SHA.
Validation and refresh both move local main to origin/main after fetching.
The report names the first failed verification stage and exit code.
Diagnostics are bounded and redact authorization values, OAuth tokens, secrets, API keys, passwords, cookies, GitHub tokens, and JWT-shaped values.
Job logs are diagnostic-only and are consulted only when bounded structured diagnostics are absent.
Generated artifacts remain restricted to the three governed frontend evidence files.

phases.objective: Route the report through the trusted canonical PR evidence publisher after the workflow definition is present on the default branch.
Exercise process spawn faults, missing reports, oversized diagnostics, stale candidates, concurrent refresh pushes, and artifact upload failures.
Observe the first non-production exact-candidate report and verify reviewers no longer require manual Job-log reading.
Require canonical structured frontend verification evidence for protected release promotion.
